result.analyst_notes: Aspirational, first-person plural voice throughout, opening with a mission statement and centering innovation as a force for good. Commitments are often hedged ('can and should', 'working to'). Diversity is framed as serving innovation. Stakeholders addressed are mainly employees and customers, with COVID-19 safety and community wellbeing. Financial and governance claims are absent.
